results.name: Close below the lower Bollinger band (daily)
results.rules: Close below the 20-day mean minus 2 standard deviations: long next open.

results.name: 7-day closing low (daily)
results.rules: Close at the lowest close of the last 7 days: long next open.

results.name: Three lower closes (daily)
results.rules: Three consecutive lower closes: long next open.

results.name: RSI(2) pullback in trend
results.rules: Above the 200-day average with RSI(2) under 10 (or below it with RSI(2) over 90).

results.name: Gap fade on light early volume
results.rules: A gap of 0.25%+ from yesterday's close with the first 15 minutes averaging under 1x normal volume for those slots (no conviction) leans AGAINST the gap direction, fired at 9:45.

results.name: Stochastic(14,3,3) crossover from overbought/oversold
results.rules: Slow Stochastic(14,3,3) on 5-minute bars. %K crossing above %D while both are below 20 (oversold) leans long; %K crossing below %D while both are above 80 (overbought) leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Break of structure (continuation), before 11:00 only
results.rules: Same event as bos (close beyond the last swing in the trend's direction) but only counted when the break closes before 11:00 ET, instead of the usual 10:00-15:00 window.

results.name: Turn of the month (daily)
results.rules: At the last trading day of the month: long from the next open.

results.name: Gap-down reversal day (daily)
results.rules: Open below yesterday's low and close above the open: long next open.

results.name: NR7 breakout
results.rules: Day after the narrowest range of the last 7 days closes beyond that day's range.

results.name: Value-area re-entry (80% rule)
results.rules: Open outside yesterday's value area, then 30 minutes of closes back inside; lean toward the far edge.

results.name: Inside-day breakout
results.rules: Close beyond the mother bar's range the day after an inside day.

results.name: Change of character (protected level breaks)
results.rules: The protected swing that held the trend is closed through.

results.name: Change of character, before 11:00 only
results.rules: Same event as choch (the protected swing that held the trend is closed through) but only counted when it closes before 11:00 ET, instead of the usual 10:00-15:00 window.

results.name: Turnaround Tuesday (daily)
results.rules: Monday closes below Friday: long at Tuesday's open.

results.name: Keltner Channel breakout
results.rules: Keltner Channel: EMA(20) midline, bands at +/- 2x ATR(14). The first close above the upper band (from inside the channel) leans long; the first close below the lower band leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 20-bar warmup.

results.name: VWAP reclaim / loss
results.rules: 30+ minutes on one side of VWAP, then a close through it on 1.2x normal volume.

results.name: EMA 9/21 crossover (golden/death cross)
results.rules: EMA9 crossing above EMA21 (golden cross) leans long; EMA9 crossing below EMA21 (death cross) leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 21-bar warmup.

results.name: Internal bar strength reversal (daily)
results.rules: Close in the bottom 20% of the day's range: long next open; top 20%: short.

results.name: Value-area edge rejection
results.rules: Probe of yesterday's VAH/VAL from inside that closes back inside on a rejection bar.

results.name: Open type: open-test-drive
results.rules: The first 15 minutes test at least 0.35 ATR opposite the eventual direction, then the IB closes at least 0.35 ATR beyond the open the other way: a fast-failing test followed by a drive. Leans with the drive.

results.name: Inside bar / NR4 at a session level
results.rules: An inside bar or an NR4 bar (narrowest of itself and the prior 3) within 0.25 ATR of VWAP or yesterday's high/low marks compression at a level. The first of the next 3 bars whose close breaks that bar's own high/low leans with the breakout, before 15:00.

results.name: Break of structure (continuation)
results.rules: Close beyond the last swing in the trend's direction.

results.name: 20-day breakout
results.rules: Daily close above the prior 20-day high (below the 20-day low).

results.name: Pull to yesterday's POC
results.rules: Open inside yesterday's value area at least 1 ATR from its POC and drifting toward it after 30 minutes.

results.name: Failed IB breakout (fade)
results.rules: IB breaks, then closes back inside within 30 minutes; lean the other way.

results.name: Order block first retest
results.rules: A displacement bar (range >= 1.5x ATR, closing in the outer third of its range) marks the last opposite-colored candle before it as an order block. The first bar that trades back into that candle's range and closes back out the displacement side confirms the block held, before 15:00. A close through the block against the displacement cancels it.

results.name: Anchored VWAP retest from the day extreme
results.rules: From 10:30 to 14:30, VWAP anchored at the session's low (or high) so far, at least 8 bars old. After 3 bars closing on the anchor's side of it, a bar that wicks to the anchored VWAP and closes back on that side in that direction leans away from the anchor. One signal per side per session.

results.name: Wyckoff spring / upthrust at the IB extreme
results.rules: After the initial balance, a bar wicks beyond the IB low (high) and closes back inside on below-average volume for that time slot (low effort) while closing in the outer half of its own range against the wick (strong result): the effort-vs-result divergence marks a spring (lean long) or upthrust (lean short), before 15:00. One per side per session.

results.name: Power-hour trend
results.rules: At 15:00, price above VWAP and above the IB high (or below both); lean with it into the close.

results.name: 61.8% retracement of the opening drive holds
results.rules: The first 30 minutes' directional push (open to its own extreme) defines the opening drive. The first bar that trades to the 61.8% retracement of that drive (measured back from the extreme toward the open) and closes back in the drive's direction confirms the level held, before 15:00.

results.name: Bollinger squeeze then expansion
results.rules: Bollinger(20,2) band width at its 20-bar low marks a squeeze; the first of the next 6 bars whose close breaks back outside that bar's own bands leans with the breakout, before 15:00.

results.name: Protected level at VWAP holds
results.rules: Pullback to a protected level within 0.25 ATR of VWAP that closes back on the trend side of both.

results.name: Acceptance outside value
results.rules: Six straight closes above yesterday's VAH (or below VAL) after 10:00; lean with it.

results.name: Whole-dollar round-number rejection
results.rules: The whole-dollar level nearest a bar's open. A bar that opens below it, wicks through it, and closes back below leans down; a bar that opens above it, wicks through it, and closes back above leans up. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Fair value gap first retest
results.rules: 3-bar imbalance (bar1 high < bar3 low, or bar1 low > bar3 high) leaves an unfilled gap; the first bar that trades back into it and closes back through the near edge confirms the gap held as support/resistance, before 15:00. A close through the far edge fills and cancels it.

results.name: Gap fill attempt
results.rules: Gap of 0.25%+ and the first 30 minutes already moving back toward yesterday's close.

results.name: Initial balance breakout
results.rules: First 5-minute close beyond the first-hour (9:30-10:30) high or low, before 14:00.

results.name: 30-minute opening range breakout
results.rules: First 5-minute close outside the 9:30-10:00 range, before 12:00; one per day.

results.name: Late-day trend continuation
results.rules: At 15:00, price at least 0.5 ATR beyond the open and on the same side of VWAP: lean with it.

results.name: Break of yesterday's poor high/low
results.rules: If yesterday's session high (low) bin was touched by more than one 5-minute bar, the auction didn't reject it cleanly (a poor high/low, unfinished business). The first close today beyond that poor high (low) leans WITH the break, before 15:00. A clean (single-touch) high/low is left untested by this setup.

results.name: 15-minute opening range breakout
results.rules: First 5-minute close beyond the 9:30-9:45 range, before 10:30.

results.name: Sweep of the IB extreme
results.rules: After 10:30, wick beyond the IB high (low) and close back inside.

results.name: Initial volume breakout
results.rules: Close beyond the high/low of the heaviest-volume bar of the first 30 minutes, on 1.5x normal volume for the time of day, before 12:00.

results.name: Sweep of yesterday's high/low
results.rules: Wick through yesterday's high (low) and close back below (above) it.

results.name: Fill through yesterday's single-print zone
results.rules: Yesterday's widest price bin touched by only one 5-minute bar (a thin, fast passage) is the single-print zone. The first bar today that trades into it and closes back out the side it entered from leans WITH that close (continuation through the thin spot), before 15:00.

results.name: EMA 9/20 pullback in trend
results.rules: EMA9 on one side of EMA20 with EMA20 sloping the same way over the last 5 bars marks a trending session. A bar that touches EMA9 against the trend and the next bar closes back beyond EMA9 in the trend's direction (and beyond the prior close) confirms the pullback held, before 15:00.

results.name: Double top / bottom at a prior-day level
results.rules: Two confirmed swing highs (lows) both within 0.3 ATR of yesterday's high (low), the second no more than 0.1 ATR above (below) the first, mark a double top (bottom) at that level. The first close back through the low (high) between the two peaks (troughs) confirms it and leans against the level, before 15:00.

results.name: Bull/bear flag after a 2-ATR impulse
results.rules: A net move over the last 4 bars of at least 2x that bar's ATR marks an impulse. The following bars form a flag as long as each one's own range stays within 60% of the impulse bars' average range and the pullback never exceeds 50% of the impulse, for up to 8 bars. The first close beyond the flag's own high (low) confirms the breakout in the impulse's direction.

results.name: Gap-and-go on heavy early volume
results.rules: A gap of 0.25%+ from yesterday's close with the first 15 minutes averaging 1.3x normal volume for those slots leans WITH the gap direction, fired at 9:45.

results.name: Engulfing / hammer at a session level
results.rules: A bullish engulfing or hammer candle within 0.25 ATR of VWAP, the developing POC, or an IB extreme leans long; a bearish engulfing or shooting star at the same levels leans short, before 15:00.

results.name: Protected level holds
results.rules: Pullback to within 0.25 ATR of the protected level, closes back on the trend side with a rejection bar.

results.name: VWAP 2-sigma snap-back
results.rules: Close outside the 2-sigma VWAP band, next close back inside; lean toward VWAP.

results.name: MACD histogram flip with VWAP agreement
results.rules: MACD(12,26,9) histogram flips from negative to positive with price closing above VWAP leans long; the mirror flip to negative with price below VWAP leans short. One signal per side per session, before 15:00, after a 35-bar warmup.

results.name: IB + initial-volume breakout outside value
results.rules: IB breakout in the same direction as an earlier initial-volume breakout, with price already outside yesterday's value area.

results.name: Open type: open-drive
results.rules: The session never moves more than 0.15 ATR against its own eventual direction through the initial balance (60 minutes) and closes the IB at least 0.75 ATR from the open: a one-way drive from the bell. Leans with the drive.

results.name: First VWAP pullback after a strong open
results.rules: 10:00 close at least 0.5 ATR beyond VWAP; the first bar that touches VWAP and closes back on the trend side, before 13:00.

results.name: POC migration by 11:30
results.rules: At 11:30 the developing POC sits outside yesterday's value area; lean the way value moved.

results.name: ABC pullback after an impulse leg
results.rules: A swing-to-swing impulse leg of at least 1.5 ATR is followed by a three-swing ABC correction (A against the impulse, B a bounce staying inside the impulse extreme, C retracing 38.2%-78.6% of the impulse and holding beyond the impulse's start). The first close back beyond B in the impulse's direction leans with the impulse resuming, before 15:00.

results.name: RSI(14) divergence at the day's high/low
results.rules: A new session high with RSI(14) lower than at the prior session-high bar (bearish divergence) leans short; a new session low with RSI higher than at the prior session-low bar (bullish divergence) leans long. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: Intraday momentum: first half hour predicts the last
results.rules: At 15:30 ET, lean in the direction of the move from yesterday's close to 10:00 ET.

results.name: Open type: open-rejection-reverse
results.rules: Anywhere in the initial balance price tests at least 0.35 ATR one way, then the IB closes at least 0.15 ATR the other way: a slower, less clean rejection than open-test-drive. Leans with the reversal.

results.name: Sweep, then VWAP cross
results.rules: Sweep of yesterday's high/low or the IB extreme, then within 30 minutes a close back across VWAP.

results.name: Classic pivot R1/S1 bounce
results.rules: Classic floor pivot P = (H+L+C)/3 from yesterday's session; R1 = 2P-L, S1 = 2P-H. A probe of R1 that closes back below it leans down toward the pivot; a probe of S1 that closes back above it leans up toward the pivot. One signal per side per session, before 15:00.

results.name: VWAP tag-and-hold in a trending session
results.rules: After six bars closing on one side of VWAP with VWAP drifting at least 0.5 ATR that way, a bar that wicks to VWAP and closes back on the trend side in the trend direction leans with the trend. One signal per side per session, 10:00 to 14:30.
results.note: fewer than 40 training trades for every variant
